𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 (𝗖𝗗𝗖) – 𝗠𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗔𝘀𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗧𝗼𝗽𝗶𝗰 𝗶𝗻 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄𝘀
If you're still doing full table loads… you're already behind.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝗖𝗗𝗖?
Tracks only new, updated, deleted records
Moves only changes (not full data)
Enables near real-time pipelines

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀:
🚫 Batch → slow, heavy, outdated data
✅ CDC → fast, efficient, always fresh data

𝗪𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝘁 𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀:
Source DB → CDC → Kafka/Stream → Warehouse → BI/AI
Backbone of real-time analytics & modern data platforms

𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗼𝗻 𝗖𝗗𝗖 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗱𝘀:
Log-based → Most efficient, production-grade
Timestamp-based → Simple but can miss deletes
Trigger-based → Flexible but adds DB overhead

𝗣𝘂𝘀𝗵 𝘃𝘀 𝗣𝘂𝗹𝗹:
Push → events sent instantly
Pull → periodic checks (slower)

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗖𝗗𝗖 𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀:
Real-time dashboards
Fraud detection
Inventory tracking
AI models with fresh data

𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗧𝗶𝗽:
If you can explain CDC architecture + trade-offs, you’re already ahead of 80% candidates.
